events.name: The Phantom of the Opera (1925) - Silent Film Classic
events.info: This event features the 1925 silent film classic The Phantom of the Opera with live organ accompaniment. It is not the Broadway stage production or a modern film adaptation.
events.pleaseNote: Experience the Magic of The Phantom of the Opera Like Never Before! Join us at the historic Alabama Theatre for a special showing of the 1925 silent film classic, The Phantom of the Opera. Immerse yourself in the eerie and enchanting world of this timeless story as it plays on the big screen, accompanied by the hauntingly beautiful sounds of our house organ, Big Bertha the Mighty Wurlitzer, performed live by the talented Tom Helms. This unique event is not just a cinematic experience but also a fundraiser for the Alabama Chapter of the American Theatre Organ Society (ATOS). Your attendance will help preserve the magic of our historic organ and support future performances. Do not miss this unforgettable evening of film, music, and history, all in support of a great cause!

events.name: The Rocky Horror Masquerade Ball
events.description:
DON"T DREAM IT!  BE IT!!! Join us for the Rocky Horror Picture Show at the Rocky Horror Masquerade Ball on Friday, October 30 at Avondale Brewery in Birmingham, AL.

The night kicks off at 6:00 PM with cash costume contests in two categories:

Best Rocky Horror Character Look-A-Like - show your Tim Curry Love!
General Category

Enjoy music from DJ Flock of Geno (Neon Electric) spinning the ghoulish grooves before the main event. At 8:30 PM, the contests leadsstraight into a screening of The Rocky Horror Picture Show with live shadow cast “Antici…pation”.

Audience participation is encouraged - come dressed to impress and ready to join in the fun.Bring your own props or buy some at check out and we will have it for you at the event. 

Schedule:

6:00 PM – Doors open & costume registration begins
8:30 PM – Costume contests & movie screening
